article.title: Orlando hosts Washington, looks to end home losing streak
article.linkText: Orlando hosts Washington, looks to end home losing streak
article.story: Washington Wizards (3-3, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Orlando Magic (2-4, ninth in the Eastern Conference) Orlando, Florida; Monday, 7:30 p.m. EST LINE: Magic -2.5; over/under is 224.5 BOTTOM LINE: Orlando takes on Washington looking to stop its three-game home skid. Orlando finished 45-37 overall and 26-26 in Eastern Conference play a season ago. The Magic averaged 26.5 assists per game on 41.0 made field goals last season. Washington finished 17-65 overall and 2-14 in Southeast Division games during the 2025-26 season. The Wizards averaged 16.0 points off of turnovers, 15.1 second-chance points and 45.2 bench points last season. INJURIES: Magic: Paolo Banchero: out (ankle), Jonathan Isaac: out (knee), Izaiyah Nelson: out (ankle), Noah Penda: out (hamstring), Jalen Suggs: out (knee). Wizards: Tristan Vukcevic: out (hip), Anthony Gill: day to day (back), Alex Sarr: day to day (knee), Jamir Watkins: out for season (acl), Justin Champagnie: out (foot). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
